alternating.criterion: abs(previous_error_squared-current_error_squared)/max(previous_error_squared, float64_tiny) <= tolerance; diagnostic only; always run T

nnls.solver: scipy.optimize.nnls on economic QR of the unchanged dictionary
nnls.active_definition_for_budget: coefficient > 0, including every positive small coefficient; no pruning

uniqueness.S_named_first: Unique Euclidean projection onto a finitely generated closed convex cone. Coefficients need not be unique in general.
uniqueness.L: Rank-r truncation unique at a positive cutoff if sigma_r > sigma_(r+1). L=0 for r=0; an already rank<=r residual is reconstructed uniquely. No joint identifiability or alternating global optimum claimed.
uniqueness.allocation: Operational convention, not intrinsic separation: vertical atoms are rank one and overlap with the low-rank family.

budget.unused_budget: Reported explicitly; no fractional singular vectors or conditional subsets
budget.legacy_rank_comparison: SVD r and SVD (r + number_of_active_atoms), separately; this is not parameter matching or an actual rank bound for full-rank band atoms

aggregation.primary_unit: document mean across every sampled layer/head in that document
aggregation.primary_statistics: median, p25, p75, IQR across document means; percentile 95% CI of this median
aggregation.bootstrap: resample document IDs with replacement, preserving all instances per block
aggregation.secondary_statistics: Pooled instance median, p25, p75, IQR; descriptive only
aggregation.paired_differences: Per-instance differences first, then document means, then the same statistics

residual.energy: sum of squared entries, signed residuals retained
residual.spectrum: all n singular values; final spectrum equals R spectrum with first r removed for named_first/alternating
residual.effective_rank: exp(-sum p_i log p_i), p_i=sigma_i^2/sum sigma^2; exactly zero residual: entropy=0, effective_rank=0
residual.normalization: both fraction of residual energy and energy/||A||^2; first four columns also individually
residual.future_entries: Included in final residual diagnostics, since low-rank truncation need not be causal. No matrix remasking in this in-sample experiment.

settings.scope: Only newly created phase21_/allocation_ artifacts and the requested e4_progress.md; inputs unchanged
